correctness.rationale: For compact invariant μ of xdot=−σx+ζz+αyz, ydot=ρ−y−xz, zdot=−z+xy (all four parameters positive), test generators on arbitrary C¹ antiderivatives of one-coordinate continuous functions. This proves all three conditional regressions. Independently checked exact polynomial cancellation L(y²+z²)=2ρy−2y²−2z² with SymPy and inspected pinned verify.py, yielding E[(y−ρ/2)²+z²]=ρ²/4 and Var(y)+E[z²]=m(ρ−m). m=0 contradicts invariant support since ydot=ρ on {y=z=0}; m=ρ forces δ_(0,ρ,0). For R=xy−z=zdot, E[R|z]=0 implies orthogonality, Var(xy)=Var(z)+E[R²], Cov(z,xy)=Var(z). Zero defect implies z constant on invariant trajectories, and by Poincaré recurrence every μ-typical such orbit reduces to equilibrium: when z≠0, x solves scalar autonomous xdot=−σx+ζz+α z²/x; when z=0, ydot=ρ−y on x=0. Therefore non-equilibrium-supported μ has positive Var(z) and E[R²], and Corr(z,xy)=1/sqrt(1+E[R²]/Var(z))∈(0,1).
